captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a compact point-of-sale cash register system. It features a rectangular dark grey base housing a sliding drawer with a slim front handle, and an angled upper control console equipped with a numeric keypad and extra menu buttons. On the back, an operator screen is mounted on a vertical support pillar. The drawer translates forward along a prismatic joint, while the rear screen is designed to swivel on a vertical axis and tilt on a horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a point-of-sale register with a rectangular drawer base, an angled upper control pod, and a rear operator screen on a swivel mount. Incorporate a prismatic joint for the sliding drawer, a revolute joint for the screen swivel, and individual push buttons on the console face.
captions.factory: The code defines a multi-part articulated assembly. The base is constructed using a hollowed-out box shape that holds a sliding drawer (modeled as a box with a handle) via a prismatic joint. The main console is built with an angled front face where individual small box primitives are arrayed to form the buttons. The rear screen and its mounting bracket are modeled using box and cylinder primitives, connected to the base via a vertical revolute joint for swiveling, and a horizontal revolute joint for tilting.
